messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Bitcoin Dogecoin
Looked up for Sarah: H15 Dual: $999, 15 TH/s + 1.08 GH/s Doge, 500 W — about $36/month power at 10¢, stacks ~21,000 sats/month, block odds ~0.09% a year; ships mid-November.

Hey, I'm Sarah! I know every miner we carry, and I'm here to help. Under twelve cents, that's a good rate for mining. Give me a second and I'll run the Harlo H15 Dual — Bitcoin + Dogecoin at that price. Roughly what do you pay, ten, eleven? If you want to answer out loud, tap the mic, or just listen.
At ten cents, the H15 Dual runs about thirty-six dollars a month in power. Sorry, you were saying?
What is the profit to make?
Looked up for Sarah: Say verbatim: "At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it." H15: ~21,000 sats/month, about $18, versus $36 power.

At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity, and that's not why people buy it. It stacks about twenty-one thousand sats a month plus Dogecoin, and takes a shot at a full Bitcoin block every ten minutes. Want the block odds?
Was it solo mine and pool mine at the same time?
Looked up for Sarah: Two separate chips, so each picks its own target: Bitcoin can run solo while Doge runs on a pool — but one mode per chip, not both at once.

You'd pick one mode at a time. Solo goes for the whole block, pool pays small and steady, and you can switch in the settings whenever you like. Which one appeals to you more? (The call ended. 3 shopper turn(s). Reply NOTHING.)
